migration_flags.title: move_id renamed to move_ids (Many2one → One2many)
migration_flags.description: In v16/v17 stock.scrap had move_id as Many2one(stock.move). In v19 this is move_ids One2many with scrap_id foreign key on stock.move. Any custom code or migration scripts referencing scrap.move_id must be updated to scrap.move_ids[0] or equivalent.

migration_flags.title: stock.valuation.layer (SVL) model absent in v19
migration_flags.description: In v16/v17, scrapping a product created a stock.valuation.layer record. In v19, no SVL model exists. Valuation is stored as 'value' field (Monetary) directly on stock.move. Any custom code, reports, or migrations reading/writing stock.valuation.layer will fail.

migration_flags.title: should_replenish field added in v19
migration_flags.description: New Boolean field on stock.scrap triggers automatic procurement rule execution after scrap. Not present in v16/v17. Migration must handle the column addition.

migration_flags.title: scrap_reason_tag_ids and stock.scrap.reason.tag model added in v19
migration_flags.description: New Many2many relation to a new model stock.scrap.reason.tag. Migration must create the new model table and the M2M relation table.

migration_flags.title: Accounting entry requires valuation_account_id on scrap location
migration_flags.description: No accounting entry is created unless the scrap destination location has valuation_account_id set. This replaces the v16/v17 product-category-based scrap account. Customers must configure the scrap location account after migration.

migration_flags.title: date_done and origin fields retained in v19
migration_flags.description: Both date_done (Datetime) and origin (Char) fields exist on stock.scrap in v19. No migration action needed for these fields.

key_findings.action_validate_flow: action_validate() → do_scrap() → _create_scrap_move() → _prepare_move_values() → move._action_done(is_scrap=True); backorder suppressed by context flag
key_findings.accounting_entry_path: move._action_done() calls _set_value() (out move) then _create_account_move(); entry: CR stock_valuation_account, DR scrap_location.valuation_account_id; conditional on real_time valuation and non-zero quantity
key_findings.valuation_engine: No SVL in v19; value stored on stock.move.value; FIFO via _run_fifo(), AVCO/Standard via standard_price * qty
key_findings.scrap_account_resolution: No _get_scrap_account() method; loss account set directly on stock.location.valuation_account_id of the scrap location
key_findings.mrp_integration: mrp/models/stock_scrap.py adds production_id, workorder_id, bom_id; _prepare_move_values override routes to production_id or raw_material_production_id
key_findings.no_undo_mechanism: No return or reversal action for done scraps; _unlink_except_done prevents deletion
key_findings.move_ids_change: Critical: move_ids is One2many in v19 (was move_id Many2one in v16/v17)
